calls.title: [Mandatory] KBYG - AI Engineer World Fair
calls.summary: The team organized for the AI Engineering World Fair at Moscone West, San Francisco, with event dates from Monday through Thursday. Key logistics include minimal booth setup scheduled for Monday afternoon, with Lyndsie overseeing the process. The booth, labeled S26, offers limited storage and features interactive elements like demos supported by $40 scratch-off coupons for engagement. The team aims to capture 75 demos and 350 scanned leads while ensuring three staff members are present at all times. Swag items like charging cables and hand sanitizer will be used to attract visitors, and daily color-coded shirts will represent experimental groupings. Lyndsie also coordinates travel logistics, while Liz provides remote support for lead management during the event.
calls.keywords: AI conference, booth management, lead scanning, event logistics, demo scheduling, swag distribution
